_provenance: Condensed assessment-criteria facts extracted with citations from the ASDAN PEQ specification v1.2 Oct 2025 (E3 pp24-35, L1 pp38-50, L2 pp52-66) for pass PEQ-L2K. Facts-with-citations, not the document (see _passpq/inputs/README.md). Command verbs kept verbatim; wording condensed. Cross-checked against SPEC_FACTS.md s15 and SPEC_FACTS_L2.md s3.

ComSkE3.title: Communication skills

acs.label: State what is meant by 'communication'
List a range of ways that people communicate
List a range of components of effective communication
List difficulties that can occur when communicating
State what is meant by 'active listening'
State the importance of using active listening skills
List components of active listening skills
State what is meant by 'feedback'
State why feedback is important for communication
List ways feedback can be demonstrated during communication
Create a plan for a communication activity

acs.label: Use the plan

acs.label: Identify personal progress in the communication activity
sub: d. peer feedback informing future development
e. an area of further development
f. future situation for communication skills

notes: group >=3 members
plan/use evidence expected via challenge leading to another PEQ unit; otherwise evidence of preparation/research required

ComSk2.title: Communication skills

acs.label: Describe what is meant by 'communication'
acs.min: a: >=4 ways · b: >=3 types · c: >=3 purposes

acs.label: Describe components of effective communication
Explain difficulties when communicating and the impact of poor communication
Describe what is meant by 'active listening'
Explain the importance of using active listening skills
Describe components of active listening skills
Define what is meant by 'feedback'
Explain why feedback is important for communication
Describe ways feedback can be demonstrated, with examples across ways, types and purposes
Create plans for communication activities
sub: c. type of communication with reason for choice
f. potential audience questions and responses
acs.min: >=2 plans covering 2 DIFFERENT ways of communicating · f: >=4 questions (2 per activity)

acs.label: Use the plans
acs.min: presentation >=4 min · discussion >=10 min · text >=500 words

acs.label: Evaluate personal progress in relation to communication
sub: a. a range of positive outcomes
b. use of active listening skills
c. how communication difficulties were managed
d. use of peer feedback to inform future development
f. future situations for communication skills
acs.min: a: >=3 positive outcomes · e: >=2 areas of further development (printed against 'f' in the requirements table, p53)

notes: group >=3 members (p54)
LO2.4/2.5 evidence expected via a challenge leading to other PEQ units, else evidence of preparing incl. topic research (p54)
spec mislabel: the >=2 areas-of-further-development requirement prints as 2.6.1 f, but 'areas of further development' is element e (p53)
